\texttt{NFR-PERF-01} & \textbf{GPU throughput}. On an NVIDIA GPU with 4 GB VRAM or more, the Balanced preset shall separate a 4-minute song into six stems in under 2 minutes (measured in M1 at about 80 s on an RTX 3050 Laptop 4 GB). & must & M1 \\
\texttt{NFR-PERF-04} & \textbf{CPU-only operation}. Without a usable GPU, the Fast preset shall separate a 4-minute song in under 5 minutes on a 6-core CPU from 2021 or newer (measured in M1 at about 2.5 minutes). & must & M1 \\
\texttt{NFR-PERF-02} & \textbf{Low-memory fallback}. On out-of-memory errors the system shall retry with smaller chunks and half precision before asking the user to fall back to CPU. & must & M3 \\

\texttt{NFR-REL-01} & \textbf{Crash safety}. Jobs shall survive application restarts and worker crashes without corrupting the library. & must & M3 \\
